title: DOU and Federal Covenants for Research Pipelines
description: A ScholarSkills package (SS-0010) that collects Brazilian official gazette publications and federal covenants through the state's own machine-readable routes: the Portal da Transparência REST API and the DOU structured search. Pagination stops at an empty answer, never at a guessed limit; the covenants filter is verified on the first rows because the API silently ignores unknown parameters. The client refuses to circumvent access controls and raises instead.
